result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there is a notable state inconsistency: the 'Pizza' filter is selected yet the displayed restaurants are poké, burger, ramen, and pasta venues. There are also minor truncation/clipping issues in the category chips and carousel cards.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category chip is shown as selected (active state), but the 'Fastest near you' and 'Popular right now' sections display non-pizza restaurants (Green Bowl Poké, Smash Bros Burgers, Trattoria pasta, Tokumaru Ramen Bar). The filter appears to have no effect on the content.
issues.suggestion: Ensure selecting a category filters the restaurant lists, or reset the chip to 'All' if the content is unfiltered.

issues.description: The last category chip after 'Healthy' is clipped at the right screen edge, showing only a sliver with no readable label.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip row padding/spacing so partially visible chips clearly indicate horizontal scrollability, or add a fade/gradient edge to signal more content.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' shows a truncated restaurant name ('Trattoria Piccol...') without an ellipsis, making it look cut off rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a text ellipsis for overflowing names or ensure the card layout truncates text gracefully within the visible card width.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card at the bottom (with the −20% badge) is cut off mid-image with no visible name, rating, or delivery info before the bottom navigation.
issues.suggestion: This may be normal scroll behavior, but consider verifying the card renders complete metadata when scrolled into view; a partial card with only an image and badge can look broken in static states.
